## Purpose

Find out which of the three objectives you already work at, so each one starts at
the right level.

## Learning objectives

- Show a repeatable count of a shelf you describe.
- Explain what a shelf label adds to a count.
- Explain what a reorder point protects against.

## Theory

None. This is a check, not a lesson. Answer from what you already do.

## Completion conditions

Each objective has been answered once, and the tutor has recorded a level for it.
